prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one exceptionally polished minimal desktop WEBSITE SECTION for 8x Social, a creator network company. This is the next section below the supplied approved reference, not another homepage. Use reference ONLY for its stone background, black typography, orange punctuation and disciplined dot language. Do NOT repeat the portrait, photography, video, platform icons, nav or headline. Make a flat 1600x1100 screenshot of a refined actual web layout, not a moodboard or room mockup.

CONTINUITY: Entire frame is the identical solid warm stone #e9e5dc page surface. 80px gutters. Top 70px breathing space, then one thin neutral horizontal rule across the shared margins. Generous but finite vertical rhythm. No rounded cards, panel fills, white dashboard, gradients, shadows, new full-screen colour scene, 3D spheres, floating objects, logo spam or tiny technical labels. This should feel like a seamless next paragraph of a Listen Labs quality website, using 8x identity rather than copying their branding.

CONTENT: the next logical section explains the two genuine offerings from 8x's website: Self Serve where the brand posts jobs, chooses creators and reviews content; Full Service where 8x handles strategy, creator coordination, content and payments. Do not invent pricing or metrics. New headline exact “Your network.\nYour way.” with a small orange full stop after 'way'. Place it top-left at x80,y160, black refined tight grotesk, around72px. On the same horizontal band at right x920,y180, understated brief sentence exact “Run it yourself, or put our team behind it.” in 25px, max28ch. Hierarchy must look designed, not a giant marketing slide.

Below at y370 a pair of large simple text selectors aligned left: “Self Serve” then “Full Service”. Active Full Service is black with a small solid orange dot preceding it and a fine orange underline. Inactive Self Serve medium grey. No pill, box or toggle track. Beneath this shared selector line the lower part forms a 55%/45% asymmetrical layout.

LOWER LEFT ART: A beautiful, large, perfectly flat editorial dot illustration, 600px wide and 330px tall. One small solid orange dot at far left, then an orderly shallow fan of black round dots extending right, opening into a broad gently curved network. The dots have carefully graded size and spacing: starts as a focused handful of dots, opens into about 14 elegant staggered paths of discrete dots, ends in a soft wide crescent of smaller sparse dots. Think a precise typographic raster drawing of one brief reaching many individual creators. Use ONLY dots, no connecting lines or arrows, no swoosh ribbon, no particles thrown randomly, no smoke, no DNA, no letters or logo concealed inside. The graphic sits directly on stone and should feel like an iconic printed brand pattern. Black dots plus the single orange origin, extremely restrained. Keep generous negative space above/below the dot fan. No labels on this art, no fake numbers. This is an abstract model of service coordination, not a data chart. Dots are crisp and tactile through graphic precision only, entirely 2D.

LOWER RIGHT at x970,y490: medium-large exact headline “We run the network.” in black, font40. Below one concise sentence in24px, exact “Strategy, creators, content and payments. Handled by 8x.” wrapping into 3 easy lines. Beneath 38px space, two open fine-rule-separated lines, exact “Creative direction & briefs” and “Creator coordination & reporting”, font19, no tick icons. One understated bottom CTA “Talk to our team” and a thin diagonal arrow, font22. No dark button. Full Service is the selected mode; do NOT display the inactive mode details or cram two pricing panels in. Everything uses a stable frame so later interaction changes just these details and the dot positions, not the page background or layout.

At the very bottom another thin neutral horizontal line and open stone space implies the page continues. Do NOT show the map now: the original orange map comes later in the page and must not be redesigned. This is an implementable, compact, understated, elegant and visually memorable section based on a single strong dot motif, balanced typography, real service content. No annotations outside the UI and no unnecessary microcopy.
